core_categories: Medication Automation; Pharmacy Management Software; Adherence Solutions; IV Compounding; Specialty Pharmacy Services
specialty_focus: Omnicell is a healthcare technology company that automates medication management and pharmacy supply workflows. It provides robotic dispensing systems, point-of-care automation, and adherence software to hospitals and health systems, aiming to reduce medication errors, lower operational costs, and improve clinician efficiency. It does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
key_brands: XT Series, EnlivenHealth, Performance Center, JVM/Hanmi Pharm, McKesson, Meditec Pty Ltd, Alphatron Medical Systems, Tecnigen S.A., Kapamed, Ad Interim, others
